description: This file is a Java test suite class named EntityUtilTestSuite, which extends EntityTestCase. It contains unit tests for the EntityUtil class, focusing on methods that manipulate lists of GenericValue entities, such as retrieving fields, filtering by conditions, and combining conditions with AND/OR logic.

classes.name: EntityUtilTestSuite
classes.description: A JUnit test suite class for testing various utility functions in EntityUtil related to lists of GenericValue objects, specifically focusing on filtering and extracting fields based on conditions.

methods.name: prepareGenericValueList
methods.description: Generates a list of GenericValue objects with test data for use in unit tests.

methods.name: testGetFieldListFromEntityList
methods.description: Tests extracting a list of a specific field ('description') from a list of entities, both with and without ensuring distinct values.

methods.name: testFilterByCondition
methods.description: Tests filtering a list of entities based on a simple equality condition on the 'description' field.

methods.name: testFilterByAnd
methods.description: Tests filtering with combined conditions using AND logic, both via a Map and a list of EntityExpr objects.

methods.name: testFilterByOr
methods.description: Tests filtering with OR logic across multiple conditions.
